meta.source: Nathan 2026-10-14 verbatim: planets are neurons, agents are transmitters. This is the math the build implements.
meta.supersedes: import://neural-system (qualitative) — this is the operational version

neural_dynamics.role_correction: Planets are the neurons — the system's thinking units. Agents are transmitters — signal carriers, NOT independent thinking units. Do not score agents as thinkers; score them as transmitters (delivery fidelity, binding specificity).

neuron.owns: state: activation x_i, threshold, recovery variable, resource levels, language-well levels
neuron.update: tau_i * dx_i/dt = -x_i + sigma(b_i + sum_j w_ji * eta_ji * s_j(t - d_ji))

terms.d_ji: travel delay along the synapse path

resonance_response.meaning: Lorentzian receptor specificity: the receiving neuron responds maximally when the transmitter's frequency matches its tuned band, falling off with detuning scaled by Q. This IS the resonant mesh selectivity, now governing response strength.
resonance_response.Q_i: receiver selectivity (high Q = narrow, demanding receptor)

transmitter.carries: source neuron, destination neuron, type, strength, phase/frequency, travel time, decay
transmitter.routing: transmitters follow the world/synapse graph — signal paths, not free flight
transmitter.lifecycle: release (on neuron firing) -> routed travel with decay -> receptor binding (eta-weighted) -> arrival changes destination neuron state -> reuptake
transmitter.gap: Current couriers move resources between planets but do NOT implement the neuron-response loop. The build must close this: arrivals change destination planet state via the update equation.

coherence.law: r * e^(i*psi) = sum_i a_i * e^(i*theta_i) / sum_i a_i
coherence.meaning: Kuramoto order parameter over NEURON phases (theta_i), amplitude-weighted (a_i). r = network coherence, psi = mean phase.
coherence.correction: Measure coherence from neuron phases — NOT by averaging agent quanta.

neural_dynamics.core_loop: neuron state -> transmitter release -> routed signal -> receptor/resonance response -> updated neuron state
neural_dynamics.queue: Operational core of the coordinated unification pass on both artifacts.
